name: Sparo Excel Engine
description: Revisioned workbook creation with formulas, semantic cell styles, number formats, worksheet layout, proposal review, undo, static formula lint, and source-safe XLSX export for Excel Live.

capabilities.title: Sparo Excel Engine
capabilities.description: Open and create revisioned workbooks; read values, formulas, basic RGB styles, and layout; propose conflict-safe content/style/layout edits; statically lint formulas without calculating them; undo; and export source-safe CSV/XLSX copies.

actions.name: openWorkbook
actions.description: Open a CSV, XLSX, or Sparo workbook JSON file into an in-memory session and persist the store under .sparo_os/excel-live.

actions.name: createWorkbook
actions.description: Create an empty workbook (default 50x26 sheet) and persist its store.

actions.name: getMeta
actions.description: Return workbook metadata including sheet layout, focus, dirty/revision state, proposal state, calculation honesty, style/layout fidelity, and precise runtime capabilities.

actions.name: getFocus
actions.description: Return the current ambient focus (sheet, A1, kind).

actions.name: setFocus
actions.description: Set the ambient focus and collaboration mode without changing workbook content revision.

actions.name: readRange
actions.description: Read a values matrix, formula subset, sparse styled-cell details, and worksheet layout for a range (defaults to current focus). Enforces maxCells (default 2000).

actions.name: summarizeRange
actions.description: Summarize a range with numeric/empty/formula counts, header guess, and sample TSV (first 20 rows).

actions.name: proposePatch
actions.description: Compute an intent-bearing content/formula/style/layout before/after proposal at an expected revision without mutating committed cells. New formulas receive static lint only, never calculation. resultCellLimit can bound returned detail without truncating the stored proposal.

actions.name: getProposal
actions.description: Return the active proposal diff, optionally bounding cell details with resultCellLimit while reporting totalCellCount and cellDetailsTruncated.

actions.name: acceptProposal
actions.description: Apply all or selected cells after revision and before-value/style conflict checks. Proposal layout is applied only on whole-proposal acceptance without cellRefs.

actions.name: rejectProposal
actions.description: Discard the active proposal without changing committed cells.

actions.name: applyLocalEdit
actions.description: Apply an undoable value, formula, or partial-merge style edit at the current workbook revision.

actions.name: applyLocalPatch
actions.description: Apply an undoable multi-cell value/formula/style patch, used by paste and direct user formatting.

actions.name: clearRange
actions.description: Clear committed cells as an undoable operation and invalidate stale proposals.

actions.name: applyLayout
actions.description: Apply undoable column widths (Excel character units), row heights (points), deterministic content-aware auto-fit sizes with an OOXML best-fit hint, freeze panes, and auto-filter metadata at an expected revision. Imported Excel packages require an acknowledged Save As rebuild for changed layout.

actions.name: undo
actions.description: Undo the latest committed workbook content operation.

actions.name: redo
actions.description: Redo the latest undone workbook content operation.

actions.name: getHistory
actions.description: Return revision and compact undo/redo operation history without cell payloads.

actions.name: saveWorkbook
actions.description: Persist the live store and export JSON or a styled/layout-aware XLSX copy. Imported Excel style/layout changes require an acknowledged lossy Save As rebuild and can never silently overwrite the source; CSV uses exportCsv.

actions.name: exportCsv
actions.description: Serialize the active (or specified) sheet to CSV, optionally writing a file.

actions.name: listSheets
actions.description: List sheets in the workbook.

actions.name: listWorkbooks
actions.description: List live workbook stores under .sparo_os/excel-live for the workspace.

actions.name: switchSheet
actions.description: Switch the active sheet by id or name.

actions.name: insertRows
actions.description: Insert one or more rows at a 0-based index.

actions.name: insertColumns
actions.description: Insert one or more columns at a 0-based index.

actions.name: deleteRows
actions.description: Delete one or more rows at a 0-based index.

actions.name: deleteColumns
actions.description: Delete one or more columns at a 0-based index.

actions.name: renameSheet
actions.description: Rename a sheet.

actions.name: addSheet
actions.description: Add a new empty sheet to the workbook.

actions.name: reloadWorkbook
actions.description: Reload from the original file path when available, otherwise from the JSON store.

tools.name: SparoExcelEngine
tools.description: Create professional workbooks with formulas, semantic styles, number formats, layout controls, reviewable proposals, and CSV/XLSX export. Formula validation is static only; this engine does not calculate formulas.
